fusions.name: Leg-Iron Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted length of links at the first enemy ahead, dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to wrap its legs and leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Ankle-High Whirl
fusions.desc: Whirls a length of links at ankle height, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Hobble Line
fusions.desc: Stretches a chain 5 tiles long at ankle height for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 25% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lockstep Cadence
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
